This blank sits inside numbered paragraph 1, whose printed sentence goes on to recite that the crime is eligible for sealing under 15 M.R.S.A. § 2261(6) and § 2262-A — a requirement the statute no longer imposes, because PL 2025, c. 513 repealed the eligible-criminal-conviction prerequisite formerly in § 2262-A(1).
